findings.title: Session budget does not reconcile with checkpoint allocation
findings.message: R1–R5 are described as five checkpoints but the budget is three sessions plus one contingency, and R4 runs in parallel with R2/R3. R1 is a half-session, R2 a half-session, R3 a full session, and R5 a half-session. That sums to 2.5 sessions without R4, which has no allocation. The estimate is therefore not clearly derived and the 'bounded' claim is weak.
findings.suggestion: Add an explicit session allocation per checkpoint, including R4 effort, and show how it totals to the stated budget.

finding.title: Two-hour soak conflicts with fix-and-retest within one session
finding.message: R3 requires 100 lifecycle cycles, ten minutes of active editing, idle samples, and a two-hour soak. The soak must come after a frozen stable candidate, yet R3 is a single session that also includes the full workflow script, scripts/check.sh, and fixes. A defect fix during R3 would invalidate the soak and force a rerun, which the plan does not account for.
finding.suggestion: State that any runtime fix restarts the soak and lifecycle checks, and reserve contingency budget for that rerun.
finding.evidence:
The soak
can run unattended alongside documentation work.
